title: French Bulldog Shedding: How Much They Shed and When to Worry
seoTitle: French Bulldog Shedding: Season, Brushing, Hair Loss
description: Do French Bulldogs shed a lot? French Bulldog shedding explained: seasonal shedding, the best brush and routine, and hair loss that points to a skin problem.
secondaryKeywords: do french bulldogs shed a lot

faq.q: Do French Bulldogs shed a lot?
faq.a: They shed lightly to moderately. The coat is short with no undercoat, so there are no big clumps, but the Royal Kennel Club still lists the breed as one that sheds.

faq.q: When do French Bulldogs shed the most?
faq.a: Dogs normally shed more in early spring and early fall, and changes in temperature or daylight also trigger shedding. Indoor dogs may shed more evenly through the year.

faq.q: What is the best brush for a French Bulldog?
faq.a: A rubber curry brush or grooming mitt works well on a short, single coat, followed by a soft bristle brush. Use metal de-shedding blades gently, if at all.

faq.q: Why is my French Bulldog shedding so much?
faq.a: A seasonal change, recent illness, pregnancy or poor nutrition can cause a heavy shed. Itchy skin from allergies or fleas is common in Frenchies and needs a vet if your dog scratches or licks a lot.

faq.q: Are French Bulldogs hypoallergenic because they have short hair?
faq.a: No. Allergy specialists say no breed is truly hypoallergenic, and allergens come from dander, saliva and urine rather than hair length.
